objective: Screen a bounded mixture-of-experts recurrent controller with addressed and global RWKV reads plus an explicit projected-only abstention arm.

authorization_basis.architectural_response: Replace the single addressed gate with normalized query-conditioned addressed/global recurrent experts and an explicit projected-only abstention arm.

architecture.zero_recurrent_identity: Both recurrent directions are zero, so the bounded correction is exactly zero and the projected carrier is returned bit-exactly.
architecture.training_boundary: This screen performs no optimization. A pass authorizes a separately locked causal training run.

execution.distribution: one locked source/donor pair per rank; no gradient or optimizer update

stopping_rule.pass: Authorize only a separately locked supervised causal training run with a new source/donor-disjoint open endpoint.
stopping_rule.failure: Archive the structural failure and redesign the recurrent controller.
stopping_rule.always: Do not open publisher validation/test, Hard32, or the unused strength holdout.
